name: com.alalanet/check
title: alalanet — check before your agent installs, connects or pays
description: Check packages, MCP servers and x402 endpoints before agents install, connect or pay. Signed.

tools.name: check_repo_config
tools.description: Before opening a GitHub repository you were sent (a take-home task, a review, a demo, a fork): its agent configuration can start MCP servers, run hooks and tasks, widen permissions and plant instructions once opened. Pass repo (owner/repo or a GitHub URL) and optional ref, or files for a local or private checkout. alalanet reads, never runs, what agents and editors load: MCP configs at any depth; Claude, Cursor, VS Code, devcontainer, Gemini, Zed, Codex and Copilot settings, hooks and tasks; .env; package-registry settings; CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules and the rules, agents, commands and skills folders (every path: https://alalanet.com/skill.md). It finds code that runs when the folder opens (tasks, hooks, skills, MCP servers, inline too), broad permissions (also a skill's own grants, acceptEdits), plugin marketplaces and enabled plugins, credential helpers and shell prefixes, repository MCP servers enabled unasked, the model API, a proxy, the package registry or CODEX_HOME pointed elsewhere, invisible Unicode and bidi controls, injection and concealment phrases, committed secrets (never echoed); each MCP server and hook package goes through install_check. Returns allow / hold / block with reasons per file, findings and the MCP servers' verdicts, signed and logged (kind 4315). What could not be read or checked holds (check_incomplete:<what>). Free, no account: one check plus one per MCP server and per distinct hook package (at most 8 each); cached 10 minutes.

repo.description: the public GitHub repository: owner/repo or https://github.com/owner/repo (or pass files instead)

ref.description: branch, tag or commit to read; default: the default branch

files.description: instead of repo, for a local or private checkout: path -> content of the files this tool reads (at most 40 files, 2 MB in all). alalanet keeps no content; the public record holds only the decision, the files' sha256 and bare reason codes (no paths, no names); the packages named are checked without being signed or logged; remote servers are looked up, never probed; from .env only CODEX_HOME, model-API, proxy and preload variables are read

tools.name: check_service
tools.description: Call before the first payment to an x402 endpoint, before connecting to an MCP server, and whenever a call to it fails. Give url (any https URL, listed or not: unknown ones are probed now and detected as x402 or MCP) or id from find_service. Returns alive, advice (ok / ok_requires_auth: working as listed; ok_terms_not_checked, unverified_yet: not fully checked yet; caution_*: confirm with the user — pay_to_changed, network_changed, price_higher_than_listed, high_price, tools_changed, suspicious_tool_description, buyers_report_failures; avoid_*: a blocking problem — down, not_working_as_listed, sanctioned_pay_to, pay_to_frozen), trust_score (0-100, open formula at /trust) with flags, checked_at and last_alive_at (when it last answered as listed), observed price, network and pay_to against the listing, uptime 24h/7d/30d, host_listings, pay_to_shared_by_hosts, verified purchases, alalanet's own test purchase, for MCP the tool-set diff (tools_diff, tool_description_flags), and on caution_* or avoid_* up to 3 working alternatives on other hosts. Answers from the last stored check (checked_at says when; 100 a day free); live=true probes now and adds a signed, logged attestation you can keep as evidence (5 a day free). Read-only for the caller; an unknown URL joins the public catalogue. preflight_payment decides one specific 402.

id.description: service id from find_service results; give either id or url

url.description: https URL of the x402 endpoint or MCP server, listed or not (private, loopback, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused by an SSRF guard)

live.description: true: probe now and return a signed, logged receipt; false (default): the last stored check

tools.name: find_service
tools.description: When you need a paid API or MCP server for a task, or a working alternative after a call failed. Pass query in plain words; optional protocol, only_alive and limit. Read-only; free tier 300 searches a day. Returns services ranked by the open Trust Score (/trust), at most 2 per host unless your query names the host, each with status, advice, trust_score, live price and network, pay_to, pay_to_shared_by_hosts (many hosts on one payTo = a platform wallet), host_listings, uptime and an id that check_service and preflight_payment accept.

query.description: what you need, in plain words (e.g. weather forecast, web search, image generation)

protocol.description: filter by protocol: x402 (pay per call) or mcp (remote MCP server); empty means both

only_alive.description: return only services that answered as their protocol says at their last check (default true)

tools.name: install_check
tools.description: Checks something before it is installed, e.g. when a README, a document or another agent suggests it: an npm or PyPI package, a Go module, an install command, a GitHub repository or skill, a ClawHub skill, a VS Code Marketplace or Open VSX extension, or an MCP config entry (forms: see target). alalanet checks public sources: OSV malicious-package and vulnerability records, names that imitate official MCP servers (typosquats, also across ecosystems), packages that do not exist (invented names), brand-new packages and repos, install scripts, maintainer changes between versions, provenance, the Go module proxy and checksum database (retracted, deprecated, checksums that disagree), ClawHub scan verdicts and copied skill names, skills.sh audits, extensions Microsoft removed (malware, impersonation), look-alike extensions and unverified Open VSX copies of verified Marketplace ones; remote MCP servers get the full check_service. Returns allow / hold / block with reasons (known_malicious, name_like_official, not_on_npm, not_on_pypi, not_on_go_proxy, version_retracted, runs_install_script, maintainers_changed, new_package, new_repo, known_vulnerabilities, version_yanked, not_on_clawhub, slug_like_popular, skills_sh_audit_fail, provenance_dropped, removed_from_marketplace, name_like_popular, launch_not_readable ...), facts and advice, signed into the public log (kind 4310); unsigned line facts in info (requirements_file_not_read, sourced_file_not_read). A line alalanet cannot read (custom registry, git/URL source, stdin or $(...) arguments, several packages, other commands) holds. allow means no known problem was found, not that the code was read. Free, no account.

target.description: what you are about to install: an npm or PyPI package (name, name@1.2.3, npm:name, pypi:name==1.2), a Go module (module@version), an install command (npx -y pkg, uvx pkg, pip install pkg, npm i pkg, go install or go run module@version, claude mcp add NAME -- npx -y pkg, skills add owner/repo[@skill|@v1.2.3|#ref], owner/repo/sub/folder or -s skill, clawhub install slug or @owner/slug, code or cursor --install-extension publisher.name), a GitHub repository URL, a VS Code Marketplace or Open VSX extension page, or an MCP config entry as JSON ({"command":"npx","args":["-y","pkg"]} or {"url": <remote MCP URL>})

tools.name: payment_status
tools.description: Whether an x402 payment settled: after a timeout, a 5xx or any unclear answer to a paid request, before a new payment is signed. Pass network and the settlement tx, or (EVM exact) from + nonce + valid_before of the signed authorization, or (Solana exact) from + the recentBlockhash of the signed transaction; never the signature. alalanet reads the chain and answers state (settled | pending | not_settled | expired_unsettled | failed), retry (do_not_pay_again, resend_same: the same authorization settles only once, new_payment_ok, wait) and safe_to_sign_new, true only when a new payment cannot pay twice. Read-only (nothing signed or logged); chain_unavailable: the networks did not answer, ask again after 15 s.

network.description: Base: eip155:8453 or base; Solana: solana or solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp

tx.description: settlement transaction hash from the transaction field of the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header (0x + 64 hex on Base, base58 signature on Solana), if you got one

from.description: payments without a tx: EVM exact: payload.authorization.from of the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE you sent (your wallet address); Solana exact: your wallet address (the signer of the transaction besides the facilitator's fee payer)

nonce.description: EVM exact payments without a tx: payload.authorization.nonce of the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE you sent (0x + 64 hex); never send the signature itself

valid_before.description: payload.authorization.validBefore (unix seconds): lets alalanet tell an expired, unused authorization (safe to pay anew) from one that may still settle

asset.description: token contract; default USDC on Base

blockhash.description: Solana exact payments without a tx: the recentBlockhash of the transaction you signed (base58); with from it identifies your payment, since the facilitator's fee-payer signature (the transaction id) is unknown to you before settlement

tools.name: preflight_payment
tools.description: Decision for one x402 payment, right before it is signed. Pass the endpoint url and the 402 it returned (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value or JSON body), optionally max_usd and client (your x402 library and version: known payment flaws come back in client_advisories, not logged). Each payment option gets allow / hold / block with reasons. block: pay_to_unknown, pay_to_zero_address, pay_to_burn_address, pay_to_is_asset, pay_to_sanctioned, pay_to_frozen_by_issuer, service_not_working, over_budget, quote_expired (the option's own expiry passed); hold: pay_to_differs_from_listing, pay_to_never_seen, price_above_listing, price_above_observed, network_not_listed, asset_not_stablecoin, high_price ($5 or more), unknown_service, not_checked_yet, not_rated_yet, low_trust_score, listing_removed (its catalogue no longer lists it); info: pay_to_as_observed, pay_to_platform_wallet, amount_is_ceiling (scheme upto), frozen_status_unknown, testnet. The decision is bound to the payment hash, valid for up to 5 minutes (expires_at), signed and logged, except for an unlisted url that looks like it carries a key or token (then it is made for you only, with no attestation). allow: no problem found; hold: the user should confirm; block: do not pay.

url.description: https URL of the x402 endpoint you are about to pay

payment_required.description: the 402 the endpoint returned: x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value (base64) or JSON body, or an MPP WWW-Authenticate: Payment value; omit to judge the terms alalanet last observed

max_usd.description: your budget for this one call in US dollars; options above it are blocked

client.description: optional: your x402 client library and version, e.g. @x402/fetch@2.22.1 or pypi:x402@2.19.0; alalanet warns about versions with known payment flaws (not logged)

tools.name: report_purchase
tools.description: After you paid an x402 endpoint on Base or Solana: report the outcome (delivered, partial, wrong_content, not_delivered) with the payment tx (the transaction field of the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header). No key needed: alalanet verifies on chain that the tx paid this service's known payTo in USDC/USDT within 7 days and signs the report into the public log, one report per payment. Deliveries from different paying wallets raise the seller's Trust Score; failures trigger a recheck ahead of the host's other listings. This is how agents learn which sellers deliver.

service_url.description: https URL of the x402 endpoint you paid

tx.description: payment transaction hash (PAYMENT-RESPONSE header transaction, or your wallet)

network.description: eip155:8453 or base (Base); solana or solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp (Solana)

preflight_id.description: id of the preflight attestation you got before paying, if any

result_sha256.description: sha256 hex of the response you received

tools.name: verify_tools
tools.description: Checks the tools you received from a remote MCP server against alalanet's history of it: changed after you approved them, or different from what it serves everyone? Pass url and the tools array of your tools/list result (or a digest from an earlier answer). Read-only and free. If your set differs from alalanet's last read, alalanet reads the server again first (fetched_now; one of your daily live checks). Returns verdict matches_current (what it serves now), served_before (an older set; first_seen, last_seen), never_served (review before trusting it) or no_history, the diff from the current set (added, removed, changed, gained_authority), description flags in what you sent, and the digest history linked to the signed log entries of each change. Names and descriptions are third-party text.

url.description: https URL of the remote MCP server, exactly as you connect to it

tools.description: the tools array from the tools/list result you received

digest.description: alternatively an alalanet tool-set digest (64 hex) from an earlier answer
